q: Reports prepared by sell-side research analysts are typically:
o: Published for the public, often free
e: Sell-side reports are published in the public domain, generally free to brokerage clients. Buy-side reports are internal; independent research is sold on subscription.

q: Which SEBI regulation is the parent rulebook for Research Analysts in India?
e: SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, 2014 govern RAs — registration, code of conduct, disclosures, personal trading, record-keeping.
